exposure: age group of the pregnant women
cohort: 794 pregnant women who participated in the Programa de Atencao as Gestantes do Programa Einstein na Comunidade de Paraisopolis, between 2011 and 2014, and who returned for the postpartum evaluation of their newborns
finding: The proportion of low birth weight was 7.6% and twining, age of the pregnant woman, and cesarean delivery were associated with the occurrence of low birth weight.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with low birth weight.
